title: Ines and the Hollow
author: P. M. Thackeray
blurb: August Villalobos, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has spent fifteen years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
